title: Data clarity — ORM names, radar interpretation, balance ranges, empty state fix
feedback: Exercise names were truncated in the 1RM section. The volume chart showed an empty state message alongside real data. The muscle group radar had no explanation. Muscle balance cards showed no healthy reference range.

title: Training Volume chart — Monday anchoring, rolling average, interpretation sentence
feedback: Weeks started on arbitrary days, not Monday. No context for whether a week's volume was high or low. Empty state text appeared below the chart even when data existed.

title: Pro chart: Muscle Group Volume Distribution radar — 28-day window
feedback: Muscle Balance ratios give two numbers. The radar gives the full structural picture across every muscle group logged — immediately reveals imbalances across the whole programme.

title: Free volume chart, live PR detection, stronger empty states
feedback: Free users saw no immediate value. All analytics were behind Pro. No real-time PR signal at the point of achievement.

title: Final positioning sweep — notifications, modals, and share language updated
feedback: Badge and challenge notifications were still surfacing in the bell panel. Avatar share buttons remained. All gamification language now removed from every visible surface.

title: Professional positioning — header, stats, rest timer, and privacy language updated
feedback: All remaining casual and motivational language removed. App now reads as a professional performance tracking tool throughout.

title: Professional positioning — vocabulary, onboarding, and Pro messaging updated
feedback: Target audience is high-performers who want objective tracking — not gamification. Language updated to reflect precision, privacy, and analytical depth.

title: Certificate gallery now shows real milestone colours — teal, lavender, amber and more
feedback: Certificate thumbnails were showing as black squares on both desktop and mobile. The trophy badge count also stayed visible after tapping it.

title: Achievements gallery — tap 🏅 to view, share, or re-download certificates
feedback: The certificate appeared once and disappeared with no way to find it again. There was also no way to share it.

title: Milestone certificates — colourful, personal, and permanent in your gallery
feedback: The certificate appeared once and disappeared. There was no way to view it again, and it was the same black-and-white template for everyone.

title: Rest timer — Reset, visual escalation, haptic pulse, PR-aware duration suggestion
feedback: No reset button, no visual cue that rest was ending, no way to know if rest duration was appropriate for the weight being lifted.

title: ER tier now shows next tier and how many training days away
feedback: Users could see their current tier but had no signal of what they were working toward next or how close they were.

title: ER Tier System — Every Rep, nine tiers from LoggER to FoundER
feedback: Users wanted a sense of identity and progression that felt earned, not gamified — specific to serious lifters who value discretion.

title: Custom workout type auto-fills from session history
feedback: Selecting Other still required manually typing the custom type every session even when it was the same as last time.

title: Voice input — reliable microphone handling on mobile
feedback: Microphone permission denied even though allowed in settings.

title: Full exercise voice logging — speak to log, auto-fill from history
feedback: Tapping through five fields per exercise while still in the gym breaks the flow.

title: Voice input for Sets, Reps, and Weight — speak numbers directly
feedback: Typing numbers between heavy sets with sweaty hands is friction that should not exist.

title: Estimated 1-Rep Max tracker — Epley formula across your full history
feedback: Serious lifters were already calculating this manually.

title: Training Fingerprint — your personal training DNA
feedback: Users wanted to see their actual training patterns, not just totals.

title: Rotation bug fixed — phone orientation no longer breaks layout
feedback: Rotating portrait to landscape and back required a page refresh.

title: Mobile exercise layout — card view with no horizontal scrolling
feedback: On mobile, scrolling left to right to add weights and reps was not intuitive.

title: Progressive Overload Signal — per-exercise weight comparison
feedback: Users wanted to know at a glance whether they were progressing.

title: Muscle Balance Ratio — Push:Pull and Quad:Hamstring over 28 days
feedback: Serious lifters wanted a structural view of their volume balance.

title: Feedback now routes via Web3Forms — direct email reply to users
feedback: Previous feedback mechanism had no reliable notification path.

title: Smoother rest timer audio — gentle start, explosive final 10 seconds
feedback: The start beep was reported as jarring.

title: Rest timer pause button
feedback: Mid-rest interruptions had no recovery path.
